body_markdown:
**New York – September 10, 2026** – Rezolve Ai (NASDAQ: RZLV), a global leader in AI-powered commerce technology, announced that its Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Daniel M. Wagner, will participate at the[H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference](https://hcwevents.com/annualconference/) in New York City on **Monday, September 14- 16, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Tim** e.


Investors who wish to request a meeting with Rezolve Ai should contact their H.C. Wainwright representative.


Rezolve Ai will also be hosting an **Investor Day on October 06, 2026** in New York City at Nasdaq MarketSite. The event will provide investors and analysts with a presentation of Rezolve’s agentic commerce business and its expanding AI infrastructure capabilities.


Investors and analysts are invited to attend the event in-person or online and are asked to pre-register at:[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/hz8x6poa/](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/hz8x6poa/)


## About Rezolve Ai


Rezolve Ai is a global leader in AI-powered commerce technology. Its Brain Suite platform helps retailers, brands and financial institutions transform how consumers search, engage and transact across digital channels.


Rezolve Ai’s proprietary brainpowa™ models are purpose-built for commerce, while TraceWare™ is designed to provide transparency and accountability across agentic AI workflows. Together, Rezolve Ai’s technology enables enterprises to deploy AI that can engage customers, understand intent, support transactions and operate safely at scale.


Headquartered in London with operations across North America, Europe and Asia, Rezolve Ai partners with leading global enterprises to power the future of commerce through AI that sells.


Learn more at[rezolve.com](https://rezolve.com/) .
